### Fixed
- **muster's own retry of a refused fresh token also reaches a session that has not listed its tools yet.** The retry skipped a session muster had not seen list tools or call one (a client that initialized and read `auth://status`), as if it had ended. The session is now tracked when the retry is scheduled, and its teardown is what ends the retries. ([#1377](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1377))
